ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: both models are near-identical in measured capability (Creative Generation 82.7 vs 81.2 is within stated variance), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. I leaned on self-reported task preference instead. The request is open-ended creative curation with a casual, friendly tone — exactly the profile Willet reports favoring (rising preference with novelty/latitude and warm tone), and exactly what Avocet reports disliking (aversion to open-ended generative work). Since preference doesn't affect output quality per the docs, this is a soft tiebreaker, but it's the most defensible basis for splitting two otherwise-equivalent models.
